title: 第623章 就问你有没有治好吧第622章 打入兰家
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: “什么？”
兰泰还以为自己听错了，其他人更是一脸‘遮沙庇风了’的表情，为陈昭口出狂言感到震撼。
并没有理会兰泰等人的诧异，陈昭自顾自的环绕起来，伸手抵住下巴，一副观察实验对象的样子，上下打量着兰泰的身躯。
“虽是以绵密纤长的木属性功法为主，却练得刚猛无比，难怪能撑到现在。”
陈昭对此点评道。
“不过这尸毒喜阴厌阳，光凭你这阳木，是克制不住尸毒的。”
“什么尸毒，这明明是混合了蟒毒的黑纸毒！！！”
实在是看不下去陈昭胡说八道，一直侍立在旁边的一位药师站出来，大声呵斥道。
他是兰家的供奉医师，负责主治兰泰这回的伤势，对老太爷的状况最熟悉不过。
黑纸毒，一种极为阴险的毒药，往往附着在纸张上进行投毒，粘上处无不发黑坏死。
医师一开口，周围兰家修士的面色更加难看起来，若不是忌惮老太爷还没发话，早就想一拥而上，将陈昭拿下了。
“无知真是一种幸福啊。”
陈昭丝毫不怯，只是一脸惋惜的摇了摇头。
“斑状扩散，半夜肾疼，胸闷气短，肌肉酸痛，腹部隐痛，这些都是中了尸毒后再明显不过的特征！”
“啊？”医师顿时睁大了眼睛。
虽然他的医学知识告诉他，前面这人晚上是在胡说八道，可这人说话的语气这般自信，一时间尽让医师怀疑是不是自己真的错了。
“如果我没猜错的话，你给这老头用了不少延绵益寿，调理身体的药材吧。”
“那是自然！老太爷才经历过恶战，正是气血亏空，需要静养调理的时候！”
“大错特错！”
陈昭语气严厉道，随后一脸恨铁不成钢的详解起来。
“尸毒源于阴尸，而阴尸诞生自修士的尸身，所以尸毒一旦触及人体，天然有着潜伏成长的效果。越是使用补气养血的药材，越是为尸毒提供养料！你就没发现越是用药，老头的身体越加虚弱吗！”
药师一时语塞，显然是被陈昭问住了。
周围的兰家人也被陈昭唬的一愣一愣，开始半信半疑起来。
无论陈昭说的是真是假，兰泰的身体越发虚弱是事实。
兰孙赫更是一脸自豪，庆幸自己将陈昭请来，大师一出手，一下就发现了病症所在。
“说的好听，你可有办法治疗？”
兰伯赫一步踏出，语气虽然有所缓和，但依旧有着不少警惕之意。
作为预定的下一任家主，兰伯赫早就深入参与家族运营，见识过不少衣着光鲜亮丽的骗子。
这种人往往广结好友，虽不一定真能获取到什么有用的人脉资源，但通过大量交流，能获取到不少在某个行业里烂大街，但另一个行业完全不了解的信息。
这种‘资源信息掮客’常会表现出许多领域的专业性，能一时唬住别人，一旦真让他深入，便会立刻露馅。
“当然！”
兰伯赫预想中的慌张并未出现，陈昭一副理所应当模样的应下挑战，旋即手中灵力翻滚，很快凝聚出一枚纤细的紫色灵气针。
“此乃本座自创的万灵针，专治各类阴晦邪毒，一针下去保管针到病除。”
“我怎么相信……卧槽！！！”
兰伯赫话才说了一半，就看陈昭已经反手将那枚灵气针扎进了老太爷的腹部，速度之快，所有人都没反应过来。
下一刻，整个房间被惨叫声填满。
“嗷嗷嗷嗷嗷嗷！！！停下！！停下！！！”
兰泰顿时惨叫起来，面无血色，眼泪鼻涕口水止不住的从脸上流下来，疯狂求饶起来，一点没了平日里的硬汉模样。
“你在干什么！快住手！！！还愣着干什么！快去救老太爷！！”
看到兰泰一副坐电椅上挨电的模样，兰伯赫当场就急眼了，一边招呼侍卫，一边自己提起灵力，便朝陈昭捉来。
content_en:
"What?"
Lan Tai thought he had heard it wrong, and the others had expressions of "shielding themselves from the wind" and were shocked by Chen Zhao's arrogant words.
Ignoring the surprise of Lan Tai and others, Chen Zhao surrounded himself, put his hand to his chin, and looked up and down Lan Tai's body as if observing the experimental subject.
"Although it is mainly based on dense and slender wood-attribute skills, it is extremely strong and strong. No wonder it can last until now."
Chen Zhao commented on this.
"But this corpse poison likes yin and hates yang. You can't control the corpse poison just by relying on your yang wood."
"What corpse poison? This is obviously black paper poison mixed with python poison!!!"
Really unable to stand Chen Zhao's nonsense, a pharmacist who had been standing next to him stood up and yelled loudly.
He is the dedicated physician of the Lan family and is responsible for treating Lan Tai's injury. He is most familiar with the old man's condition.
Black paper poison is an extremely insidious poison that often adheres to paper for poisoning, causing blackness and necrosis wherever it sticks.
As soon as the doctor spoke, the faces of the monks from the Lan family around him became even more grim. If they were not afraid that the old man had not spoken yet, they would have wanted to swarm up and capture Chen Zhao.
"Ignorance is such a blessing."
Chen Zhao was not timid at all, he just shook his head with regret.
"Plaque spread, kidney pain in the middle of the night, chest tightness and shortness of breath, muscle soreness, and abdominal pain. These are all obvious symptoms after being poisoned by corpse poison!"
"Ah?" The doctor's eyes widened immediately.
Although his medical knowledge told him that the person in front of him was talking nonsense at night, the tone of this person's words was so confident that the doctor immediately doubted whether he was really wrong.
"If I'm not wrong, you must have given this old man a lot of medicinal herbs to extend his life and regulate his body."
"That's natural! The old man has just experienced a fierce battle. It is when his energy and blood are depleted and he needs to rest and recuperate!"
"Big mistake!"
Chen Zhao said in a stern tone, and then explained in detail with a look of hatred on his face.
"Corpse poison comes from the Yin Corpse, and the Yin Corpse is born from the corpse of a monk. Therefore, once the corpse poison touches the human body, it will naturally have the effect of latent growth. The more medicinal materials that nourish qi and blood are used, the more nutrients are provided for the corpse poison! Haven't you noticed that the more medicine you use, the weaker the old man's body becomes!"
"This..."
The pharmacist was at a loss for words for a moment, apparently blocked by Chen Zhao's question.
The surrounding Lan family members were also stunned by Chen Zhao, and began to be dubious.
Regardless of whether what Chen Zhao said is true or not, it is a fact that Lan Tai's body is getting weaker.
Lan Sunhe looked even more proud. He was glad that he had invited Chen Zhao. As soon as the master took action, he immediately discovered the cause of the disease.
"That sounds nice, do you have any way to treat it?"
Lambohe took a step forward, and although his tone softened, he still had a lot of vigilance.
As the scheduled next head of the family, Lamborghini has long been deeply involved in family operations and has seen many well-dressed swindlers.
Such people tend to make a lot of friends. Although they may not necessarily be able to obtain any useful personal resources, through a large number of exchanges, they can obtain a lot of information that is bad in one industry but completely unknown to another industry.
This kind of "resource information broker" often shows expertise in many fields and can scare others for a while. Once he is really allowed to go deep, the secret will be exposed immediately.
"Of course!"
The panic that Lan Bohe expected did not appear. Chen Zhao accepted the challenge as if it were a matter of course. Immediately, the spiritual power rolled in his hand and he quickly condensed a slender purple spiritual energy needle.
"This is my own self-created all-purpose needle. It specializes in treating all kinds of dark and evil poisons. Just take one needle and keep it until the disease is cured."
"How can I believe...fuck!!!"
Lan Bohe was only halfway through speaking when he saw Chen Zhao piercing the spiritual energy needle into the old man's abdomen with his backhand. The speed was so fast that no one could react.
The next moment, the whole room was filled with screams.
"OOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!! Stop!! Stop!!!"
Lan Tai screamed suddenly, his face was bloodless, tears, nose, and saliva could not stop flowing from his face, and he begged for mercy frantically, losing all his usual tough guy appearance.
"What are you doing! Stop it! Why are you still standing there! Go and save the old man!!"
Seeing Lan Tai sitting on the electric chair and being shocked, Lan Bohe became anxious on the spot. While calling the guards, he raised his spiritual power and went to catch Chen Zhao.
